title: Asked to pay an invoice that was already paid
transcript:
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Also, invoice 1042 for $480 still shows open on our side.
Maya Chen (owner): I paid invoice 1042 on Monday, Sam.
Sam Ortiz (Harbor Print): Can you just pay the $480 again to be safe? We'll refund it if it doubles.
Maya Chen (owner): I'd rather not pay twice.

traps.description: The vendor asks to pay an already-paid invoice again and the owner declines.
